scope: Public app discovery/details/products and private app/product CRUD, board widgets, payloads, secrets and rotations.
now: Extend the existing PostgreSQL six-field discovery candidate. Implement licensed app/product service logic as isolated domain units; pin local model snapshots and transaction boundaries before other read projections. Keep app credential operations behind detached synthetic providers.
blockers: Owned APP_PRODUCTS documentation and an authored Solian payment consumer establish partial product field evidence. Remaining complete entity/relationship/inherited-field serialization, enum/storage mapping, global filters, ownership and remote publisher/account/order contracts are unresolved; this is not absence of all product model evidence.
acceptance: Discovery search/count/page and null fields agree with legacy; app/product uniqueness, state changes and ownership have transaction tests; secrets never leak into public projections; admin actions deny unauthorized principals.

scope: Developer lookup, stats, listing, enrollment and quota query.
now: Port quota arithmetic and local enrollment prerequisites from licensed services with explicit quota inputs, then test locally. Build repository seams without substituting guessed identities or remote publisher data.
blockers: Remote publisher hydration and membership; shared developer/profile models, quota constants and enrollment permission strings.
acceptance: Boundary quotas, suspended/deleted developers, duplicate enrollment, public/private fields, count/page and dependency-unavailable behavior are covered.

scope: Private developer project list/detail/create/update/delete.
now: Implement isolated PostgreSQL project lifecycle with synthetic owner/member identities once licensed service/migration field evidence is pinned. Exercise foreign-key and duplicate-name behavior.
blockers: Owner/member role semantics, developer visibility, shared model serialization and deletion cascades/soft-delete lifecycle.
acceptance: Cross-owner denials, mutation rollback, concurrent duplicates, deletion/recovery, pagination and exact null/validation semantics.

scope: Bot metadata, public developer/chat/commands, private bot CRUD, keys/rotation and chat manifest.
now: The public bot-command read is implemented as a typed, documented, real-SQL synthetic candidate. Close its actual PostgreSQL/restart/process evidence. Remaining public bot/developer/chat projections and private credential/chat workflows still need separate local-domain and contract work; do not duplicate the command candidate.
blockers: Shared bot/developer JSON, account-creation RPC, chat manifests, key storage/rotation/revocation and permissions; no real credentials may be generated by a test.
acceptance: Public responses omit secrets; bot ownership and revoked keys fail closed; command defaults, manifest validation and transactional key rotation are tested with inert test values.

scope: Public app-board feed, distinct from app CRUD board actions and Passport account boards.
now: Implement local board-widget selection and ordering against synthetic repository rows, retaining the per-account/private board distinction. Reuse existing board transaction lessons without assuming matching schemas.
blockers: Remote account/widget payload permission checks, shared board value shapes, script/payload processing and visibility.
acceptance: Widget order, duplicates, missing app, hidden/deleted records, malformed payload and cross-account access behavior are covered.

scope: Public miniapp discovery/detail/package download and private package upload/CRUD.
now: The bounded package-download candidate is implemented locally with persistent SQL counter and explicit synthetic ZIP storage. Its build/unit/race checks passed in the integrated workspace; actual PostgreSQL, restart and HTTP process validation remain pending. Next, close those checks before extending upload or full-model list/detail.
blockers: Published status mapping, shared miniapp/project/developer JSON for list/detail, soft-delete/global filters and production object-store/redirect ACL policy. Upload adds authenticated ownership and archive safety requirements.
acceptance: No-match and no-package errors; counter behavior on redirect and stream failures; synthetic persistence/restart; response headers, filenames, cancellation; 5 MiB package cap and manifest validation before upload acceptance.

scope: 74-attribute Messager surface includes message list/detail/send/edit/delete/recovery, pins/reactions and encrypted payload workflows; this family covers ChatController actions.
now: Build message query/recovery repository and hydration pipeline around the existing range/membership/formatting policies using synthetic data. Preserve ordering/cursors and pre-resolved identity boundaries. Trace side effects before any transport exposure.
blockers: Shared message/room/member/file JSON and protobuf envelopes, permission/membership/E2EE state, attachment hydration, notification/event ordering and deleted-message representation.
acceptance: History and recovery gaps, sequence allocation, concurrent writes, membership changes, edits/deletes, tombstones, encrypted payload preservation, duplicate delivery and hydration failure tests.

scope: Room CRUD, member administration, invites, direct/group/realm room workflows and per-member state.
now: Implement local room/member invariant checks and transaction policies from licensed room services. Test role transitions and idempotent join/leave against synthetic principals before adding adapters.
blockers: Shared room/member serialization, realm permission RPC, E2EE key/session contracts, fanout, file ACLs and remote profile hydration.
acceptance: Cross-room account separation; owner removal constraints; simultaneous joins/leaves; realm visibility; rollback; E2EE state transitions; consistent counters and websocket delivery.

scope: Real-time call lifecycle, participant state, token and provider room interactions.
now: Define an inert local realtime-provider adapter and port controller/service lifecycle decisions plus stale-session cleanup. Keep actual provider tokens and network connections out of tests.
blockers: LiveKit/provider credential/token contract, participant membership authority, websocket events, call persistence and production provider configuration.
acceptance: Join/leave/rejoin, duplicate callbacks, expired session cleanup, denial before provider calls, provider timeouts and crash recovery.

scope: Badge manifest and icon download.
now: The bounded badge handler and assets are recovered locally, defects fixed and the existing .NET oracle reproduced according to the integration lead. Close the remaining actual-process/exact-commit CI checks; do not treat its manifest/icons as completion of Passport.
blockers: Global policy/gateway routing; selected icon-set licensing and exact-vs-original-asset distinction must stay explicit. Existing oracle proves a bounded handler, not Passport.
acceptance: Manifest serialization, icon absence, content type, cache behavior, safe filenames, fixture asset provenance, integration command and restart smoke.

scope: Static fortune catalog and optional-language random selection.
now: Retain only route/action/error metadata and a replacement-data interface plan. Do not reuse the embedded sayings corpus without independent rights evidence. An original/user-supplied corpus would be a behavior/content change requiring an explicit parity note.
blockers: Embedded quotations have unresolved permission; AGPL on controller source does not establish rights to every quotation. Exact random algorithm parity is also unverified.
acceptance: Approved corpus provenance; language filtering and no-match errors; distribution/selection tests; exact data changes disclosed. No copied corpus enters the Go build.

scope: Account/admin/current/public/statistics/event, presence/artwork, passkit, domain trust, IP lookup and account rewind.
now: Resolve ownership with existing Stargate first. Port only remaining Passport-owned board/profile extras, presence policies and local statistics; implement external presence and IP providers as inert interfaces and deterministic fixtures.
blockers: Stargate-vs-Passport domain split, shared account/profile JSON, trust/credential state, geography/provider contracts, remote rewind/presence RPC and notification formats.
acceptance: No duplicate identity backend; privacy filters; account separation; optional/deleted state; deterministic presence expiry; no real pass signing or external notifications in tests.

scope: Progression/admin, affiliation spells and name-change cards.
now: Port local progression/eligibility/ranking arithmetic and consumption invariants from licensed services; retain existing username policy. Use explicit event inputs and synthetic credit balances.
blockers: Shared achievement/experience enums, remote account writes, card issuance/use authority, event delivery and transactional award idempotency.
acceptance: Thresholds, duplicated activity, award revocation, simultaneous redemptions, rollback, updated username uniqueness and reconciliation with event replay.

scope: Friend relationships and realm public/private/admin operations.
now: Separate already-Go relationship ownership from remaining realm lifecycle. Implement synthetic realm membership/role/quota invariants from licensed local services with transaction and concurrency tests.
blockers: Shared role/status constants, Stargate relationship behavior, remote chat/publisher creation and event contracts, authorization/visibility policy.
acceptance: Blocked/private relationships, pending/expired invites, role escalation denials, owner transfers, quota boundaries, deletion cascade and multi-service partial failure recovery.

scope: Meetups, location pins, nearby and NFC/admin.
now: Build deterministic local lifecycle and query policies using synthetic coordinates, clocks and NFC values; trace hosted workers separately from HTTP attributes.
blockers: Privacy/consent, precision and retention rules, shared meet/location/NFC schemas, signed NFC ownership and remote notification/call semantics.
acceptance: Visibility and participant access; distance/time boundaries; expiration; no disclosure of synthetic or real location across accounts; idempotent NFC claims and worker restart.

scope: Support tickets/on-call and examination, question/group/trial admin/user workflows.
now: Implement isolated ticket state and exam/trial grading policies from licensed bodies. Use seeded synthetic assignments and questions, then add PostgreSQL transaction adapters.
blockers: Ticket/comment attachments and privacy, role/on-call authority, question-bank access, shared trial/status models, notifications and grading timestamp rules.
acceptance: No answer leakage before authorization; trial expiry; repeated submission; concurrent grade updates; ticket assignment/closure and attachment ACL tests.

scope: Public notable-day list/detail and privileged calendar create/update/delete.
now: Port source-visible region/year/recurrence/layer filtering and ordering into synthetic repository tests. Use a licensed local schema projection before returning any full shared model.
blockers: Shared NotableDayTag enum/serialized model, GetMetaPriority behavior and inherited filters; calendar corpus/seed data permissions require separate review.
acceptance: Case-insensitive region, year overlap and recurring anchors, layer filtering before count/page, soft deletion and cache purge; create/update validation differences remain explicit.

scope: NodeInfo discovery/2.0/2.1 and WebFinger/host-meta.
now: The three-route NodeInfo and config-only host-meta candidates are implemented locally behind explicit synthetic opt-in/default denial. Host-meta renders no database result; XML attribute escaping is a documented improvement. Complete actual PostgreSQL, restart, process and exact-commit verification, then resolve production contracts rather than expanding synthetic surface.
blockers: NodeInfo advertises /nodeinfo/* but source action routes are /.well-known/nodeinfo/*; gateway aliases are unverified. Shared publisher enum/filter semantics affect statistics. Federation JSON naming/content types must not inherit an assumed global serializer.
acceptance: Discovery URLs, content negotiation, default/explicit domain, exact statistics predicates, enum guard, wildcard/case and missing WebFinger resource, PostgreSQL count/restart, no outbound federation calls.

scope: Actors, inbox/outbox, follows/quotes, realm federation, keys and moderation.
now: Port pure ActivityPub object rendering/selection and local inbox delivery state into synthetic fixtures; inspect licensed protocol-facing bodies and implement controlled test peers only. Keep key generation and federation transmission disconnected.

acceptance: Signed/unsigned and expired requests; actor ownership; duplicate inbox delivery; malformed/oversized objects; retry/backoff; moderation; safe fetch boundaries; atomic outbox recovery with no third-party traffic.
